title: Blue Sky Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly explain Rayleigh scattering and its effect on the color of the sky.

title: Sunset Color Reasoning
description: Essential Criteria: The explanation must detail how the thickness of the atmosphere affects the scattering of sunlight at sunset.

title: Rainbow Formation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must describe how refraction of light by water droplets leads to the formation of a rainbow.

title: Twinkling of Stars
description: Essential Criteria: The answer should mention the role of air density fluctuations in the twinkling of stars.

title: Use of Figures
description: Important Criteria: The response should reference relevant figures to support explanations where applicable.

title: Wavelength Dependency
description: Important Criteria: The explanation should include the concept of wavelength dependency in scattering and refraction.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid incorrect statements about the scattering process or misinterpretation of atmospheric effects.

title: Clarity and Conciseness
description: Optional Criteria: The response should be clear and concise, effectively communicating complex ideas without unnecessary jargon.
